get.description: Ordered steps of a few fixed types (download_artifact, download_input, write_file, chmod, run, instructions) plus launch and save metadata. Placeholders {install}, {data} and {home} are for the client to fill in. Ask for the most specific platform key (e.g. linux-x64-steamdeck); the server falls back as needed.

get.summary: Get a job with its log

get.description:
A `text/event-stream` of hints for live UIs. Each event has a type and a JSON payload:

- `job.updated`: `{id, kind, recomp_id, game_id, status, progress, message}`
- `recomp.updated`: `{id}`: re-read the recomp
- `recomp.update_available`: `{id, version}`
- `game.updated`: `{id}`: the game, its inputs or scan suggestions changed

Events can be dropped when a client is slow; re-read state from the API after reconnecting. Browsers can't set headers on EventSource, so read the stream with fetch() and the Authorization header.
